title.en: Tale 12 — The Hare and the Lion

sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: بغابة تانية، كان في أسد.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: in another forest, there was a lion.

sentences.ar: كان بياكل من الحيوانات كل يوم.
sentences.en: He ate from the animals every day.

sentences.ar: ما كان يصيد واحد وبس.
sentences.en: He did not hunt just one.

sentences.ar: كان يقتل كتار، وياكل واحد.
sentences.en: He killed many, and ate one.

sentences.ar: الحيوانات خافت إنها تخلص كلها.
sentences.en: The animals feared they would all be finished.

sentences.ar: فاجتمعوا وراحوا عنده وقالوا: يا ملك، عنا اقتراح.
sentences.en: So they gathered, went to him and said: my king, we have a proposal.

sentences.ar: كل يوم منبعت لك واحد منا لحاله، تاكله بلا تعب.
sentences.en: Every day we send you one of us by himself, for you to eat without effort.

sentences.ar: وإنت ما بتطلع للصيد ولا بتقتل غيره.
sentences.en: And you do not go out hunting or kill anyone else.

sentences.ar: الأسد فكر، ووافق.
sentences.en: The lion thought, and agreed.

sentences.ar: الأكل بيجي لحاله، ليش يتعب؟
sentences.en: The food comes by itself; why should he tire himself?

sentences.ar: ومرت الأيام، وكل يوم بيروح واحد وما بيرجع.
sentences.en: And the days passed, and every day one went and did not come back.

sentences.ar: وبيوم، إجا الدور على أرنب زغير.
sentences.en: And one day, the turn came to a small hare.

sentences.ar: كان زغير، بس كان أذكى واحد بالغابة.
sentences.en: He was small, but he was the cleverest one in the forest.

sentences.ar: قال للحيوانات: أنا رايح، بس خلوني أروح على مهلي.
sentences.en: He said to the animals: I am going, but let me go in my own time.

sentences.ar: وإذا رجعت، بترجع الغابة كلها معي.
sentences.en: And if I come back, the whole forest comes back with me.

sentences.ar: ما فهموا شو قصده، بس تركوه.
sentences.en: They did not understand what he meant, but they let him go.

sentences.ar: الأرنب راح عالقصد متأخر.
sentences.en: The hare went late on purpose.

sentences.ar: تأخر لحد بعد الظهر.
sentences.en: He delayed until after noon.

sentences.ar: لما وصل، كان الأسد جعان وغضبان.
sentences.en: When he arrived, the lion was hungry and angry.

sentences.ar: زعق: وين كنت؟
sentences.en: He roared: where were you?

sentences.ar: وليش إجيت لحالك زغير هيك؟
sentences.en: And why have you come alone, small like this?

sentences.ar: قال الأرنب وهو بيرجف: يا ملك، ما جيت لحالي.
sentences.en: The hare said, trembling: my king, I did not come alone.

sentences.ar: بعتوني مع أرنب تاني، أكبر مني وأسمن.
sentences.en: They sent me with another hare, bigger and fatter than me.

sentences.ar: بس بالطريق طلع علينا أسد، وأخده.
sentences.en: But on the road a lion came out at us, and took him.

sentences.ar: قال الأسد: أسد؟
sentences.en: The lion said: a lion?

sentences.ar: بغابتي؟
sentences.en: In my forest?

sentences.ar: قال الأرنب: وقال إنه هو الملك، مش إنت.
sentences.en: The hare said: and he said that he is the king, not you.

sentences.ar: قام الأسد، وشعره وقف.
sentences.en: The lion rose, his mane bristling.

sentences.ar: قال: وديني عليه.
sentences.en: He said: take me to him.

sentences.ar: مشى الأرنب قدامه لحد ما وصل على بير قديم وعميق.
sentences.en: The hare walked ahead of him until he reached an old, deep well.

sentences.ar: قال: هو هون، تحت، مستخبي.
sentences.en: He said: he is here, below, hiding.

sentences.ar: الأسد طل بالبير، وشاف أسد تحت.
sentences.en: The lion looked into the well, and saw a lion below.

sentences.ar: كان خياله بالمي، بس هو ما عرف.
sentences.en: It was his reflection in the water, but he did not know.

sentences.ar: زعق عليه، والأسد اللي تحت زعق كمان.
sentences.en: He roared at it, and the lion below roared too.

sentences.ar: ورجع الصوت من البير أقوى من صوته.
sentences.en: And the sound came back from the well stronger than his own voice.

sentences.ar: قال الأسد: بتزعق عليّ؟
sentences.en: The lion said: you roar at me?

sentences.ar: أنا الملك!
sentences.en: I am the king!

sentences.ar: ونط على خياله.
sentences.en: And he leapt at his reflection.

sentences.ar: ووقع بالبير، وما طلع.
sentences.en: And he fell into the well, and never came out.

sentences.ar: رجع الأرنب على الغابة لحاله، وقال: خلص.
sentences.en: The hare went back to the forest alone, and said: it is done.

sentences.ar: وما حدا صدق، لحد ما راحوا وشافوا البير.
sentences.en: And no one believed him, until they went and saw the well.

sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: القوي اللي ما بيفكر، بيقتله الضعيف اللي بيفكر.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: the strong one who does not think is killed by the weak one who does.

sentences.ar: وأكتر إشي بيقتل الملك، إنه يشوف عدو بكل مكان.
sentences.en: And the thing that kills a king most is seeing an enemy everywhere.
